en: The Hymn to the Six Perfections:
By the power of giving, the Buddha has arisen; by the mastery of the power of giving, he is the lion among men.
The sound of the power of giving is heard as the Compassionate One enters the city. (1)
The Buddha has arisen through the power of ethical discipline; the Lion among Men is the sovereign lord of the power of ethical discipline.
The sound of one who observes the power of ethical discipline is heard as he enters the city with compassion. (2)
The Buddha has arisen through the power of patience; the Lion among Men possesses mastery over the power of patience.
The sound "Behold the power of patience! is heard as the Compassionate One enters the city. (3)
The Buddha has arisen through the power of vigor; the Lion among Men is the sovereign of the power of vigor.
The sound of one who observes the power of vigor is heard as he enters the city with compassion. (4)

The Buddha has arisen through the power of meditation; by the sovereignty of the power of meditation, O Lion among Men, the sound is heard of the Compassionate One as he enters the city, observing the power of meditation. (5)
The Buddha has arisen through the power of wisdom; by the sovereignty of the power of wisdom, he is a lion among men.
The sound of one who observes the power of wisdom is heard as the Compassionate One enters the city. (6)
